description: Implementation of the rx::Image9 class, which manages Direct3D 9 surfaces for textures, including mipmap generation, copying, locking, unlocking, and data loading.

classes.name: rx::Image9
classes.description: Manages Direct3D 9 surfaces for textures, providing functionality for mipmap generation, copying, locking, unlocking, and data loading.

methods.name: GenerateMip
methods.description: Generates a mipmap level by copying and processing surface data.

methods.name: GenerateMipmap
methods.description: Creates a mipmap from a source Image9 to a destination Image9.

methods.name: CopyLockableSurfaces
methods.description: Copies data between two lockable Direct3D surfaces.

methods.name: CopyImage
methods.description: Copies image data from source to destination surface with optional flipping and premultiplied alpha.

methods.name: redefine
methods.description: Defines or redefines the texture image with specified type, format, and size.

methods.name: createSurface
methods.description: Creates a Direct3D surface for the image if it doesn't exist.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Locks the surface for direct pixel access.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the surface after pixel access.

methods.name: getD3DFormat
methods.description: Returns the D3D format of the surface.

methods.name: isDirty
methods.description: Checks if the surface has been modified and needs updating.

methods.name: getSurface
methods.description: Retrieves the surface, creating it if necessary.

methods.name: setManagedSurface2D
methods.description: Sets the surface from a 2D texture storage.

methods.name: setManagedSurfaceCube
methods.description: Sets the surface from a cube map texture storage.

methods.name: setManagedSurface
methods.description: Sets the surface directly, replacing the current one.

methods.name: copyToStorage
methods.description: Copies the surface data to a texture storage.

methods.name: copyToSurface
methods.description: Copies a region of the surface to another surface.

methods.name: loadData
methods.description: Loads pixel data into the surface.

methods.name: loadCompressedData
methods.description: Loads compressed pixel data into the surface.

methods.name: copyFromRTInternal
methods.description: Copies data from a render target to the surface.

methods.name: copyFromTexStorage
methods.description: Copies data from a texture storage to the surface.

methods.name: copyFromFramebuffer
methods.description: Copies data from a framebuffer to the surface.
